title.narrative: Strategic Support For Humanitarian Response In Mozambique

description.narrative: AA Mozambique intends to invest funds from the PPL in strategic consolidation of the humanitarian response strategic priority specifically by co-financing the role of humanitarian policy and programme manager (HPPM), to give direction and vision of humanitarian support provided in Mozambique, having suffered significantly the effects of cyclones, El Nino and currently La Nina, but has set up preventive interventions to minimize effects on livelihoods in communities in Sofala district. Financing this position helps in consolidation and replication to other provinces and LRPs, deepening understanding and implementation of the Humanitarian Signature, etc. PPL will fund the position of Security Officer and Monitoring and Evaluation assistant, positions which are difficult to fundraise for but necessary in Mozambican Context.

activity-date.narrative: April 2025-March 2026 will be funded by People's Postcode Lottery International Trust 25/26 April 2026- March 2027 will be funded by People's Postcode Lottery International Trust 26/27
